newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa freight unit still loss-making.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa freight unit still loss-making.

text.p: Deutsche Lufthansa AG's freight business continued to make losses in the third quarter of the year, bringing its total loss for the year so far to 66 million marks, the German airline said on Thursday.

It said its Lufthansa Cargo division was suffering from overcapacity and falling prices. While breakeven was expected in the fourth quarter of this year, the unit was not likely to turn in a full-year profit until 1998.
"Then we expect it to be back in the black," Lufthansa finance chief Klaus Schlede told a news briefing to present the airline's nine month results.
In the first nine months of 1995 Lufthansa Cargo made a small profit of 12 million marks
The airline said the main problem in air cargo markets was an "inadequate price level" resulting from continued overcapacity.
Lufthansa Cargo carried 1.22 billion tonnes of freight and mail in the first nine months of the year, a small rise on the 1.15 million tonnes carried in the same time last year.
Turnover was virtually flat at 2.46 billion marks.
